coverage_taxonomy.cardinal_guardrail: ABSENCE OF A FINDING DOES NOT IMPLY ABSENCE OF GENETIC RISK. GenomePulse analyzes only targeted single-nucleotide polymorphisms interrogated by consumer arrays. It does not perform full gene sequencing, does not analyze unprobed exonic or intronic regions, and cannot detect large copy-number variations (CNVs), balanced translocations, or structural repeats.

manifest.privacy_policy: All primary genomic analysis executes locally in-browser via Web Workers. No raw genotypes, rsIDs, or derived health indicators are transmitted to online endpoints.

interpretation.phenotype_summary: APOE-ε4 is the primary genetic susceptibility factor for late-onset Alzheimer's disease.

CC.phenotype: APOE ε4/ε4 homozygote: ~12-15× elevated lifetime risk of late-onset Alzheimer's disease.
CC.user_guidance: High lifetime risk factor; clinical risk is modified by cardiovascular health, aerobic activity, and sleep quality.

CT.phenotype: APOE ε4 carrier (ε3/ε4 or ε2/ε4): ~3-4× increased lifetime risk of late-onset Alzheimer's disease.
CT.user_guidance: Single ε4 copy conveys moderate lifetime risk elevation. Diplotype resolution with rs7412 required.

TT.phenotype: Non-ε4 at rs429358 (ε3 or ε2 allele present). Baseline population risk.
TT.user_guidance: Baseline population risk for Alzheimer's disease at this locus.

caveats: APOE-ε4 is a risk factor, neither necessary nor sufficient to cause Alzheimer's disease.
Clinical interpretation requires simultaneous evaluation of rs7412 to assign the ε2/ε3/ε4 diplotype.

interpretation.phenotype_summary: HFE C282Y is the primary cause of hereditary hemochromatosis type 1 (iron overload).

AA.phenotype: HFE C282Y homozygote: Primary genetic cause of Type 1 Hereditary Hemochromatosis.
AA.user_guidance: Homozygous for the high-impact C282Y mutation. Serum ferritin and transferrin saturation monitoring recommended.

AG.phenotype: HFE C282Y carrier: Transmits allele to 50% of offspring. Risk of compound hemochromatosis if paired with H63D.
AG.user_guidance: Carrier of C282Y. Unlikely to develop iron overload alone, but risk increases if paired in trans with H63D.

GG.user_guidance: Negative for the C282Y pathogenic mutation.

caveats: ACMG Secondary Findings locus caveat: This finding represents interrogation of a single specific nucleotide locus only. It does NOT represent comprehensive clinical sequencing of the gene. A negative result at this single position does not rule out other pathogenic variants across the remainder of the gene.
Penetrance of C282Y homozygosity is incomplete; non-genetic factors influence actual iron accumulation.

rs6025.name: Factor V Leiden (c.1601G>A, p.Arg534Gln)

evidence.clinvar_condition: Thrombophilia due to activated protein C resistance

interpretation.phenotype_summary: Factor V Leiden causes resistance to activated protein C, conferring venous thromboembolism risk.

TT.phenotype: Factor V Leiden homozygote: ~50-80× elevated lifetime risk of venous thromboembolism (VTE).
TT.user_guidance: Markedly increased thrombotic risk. Hematology consultation recommended; prophylactic anticoagulation during high-risk events.

CT.phenotype: Factor V Leiden heterozygote: ~3-8× elevated risk of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.
CT.user_guidance: Heterozygous carrier. Avoid prolonged immobility and consider non-estrogen contraceptives.

CC.phenotype: Normal genotype: Negative for Factor V Leiden.

caveats: Most individuals with heterozygous Factor V Leiden do not develop thrombosis without additional triggers (surgery, estrogen, trauma).

rs1799963.name: Prothrombin G20210A (c.*97G>A)

evidence.clinvar_condition: Thrombophilia due to elevated prothrombin levels

interpretation.phenotype_summary: Prothrombin G20210A increases 3' end processing efficiency, raising plasma prothrombin levels and thrombotic risk.

AA.phenotype: Prothrombin G20210A homozygote: Markedly elevated prothrombin levels and substantial thrombotic risk.
AA.user_guidance: Homozygous for G20210A; significant elevation in venous thrombosis predisposition.

AG.phenotype: Prothrombin G20210A carrier: ~2-3× elevated risk of venous thromboembolism.
AG.user_guidance: Heterozygous carrier of G20210A. Co-occurrence with Factor V Leiden produces synergistic risk.

GG.phenotype: Normal genotype: Negative for Prothrombin G20210A.

caveats: Independent assortment on chromosome 11; multiplies thrombophilia risk synergistically if combined with Factor V Leiden (Chr 1).

interpretation.phenotype_summary: CFTR deltaF508 is the most common severe cystic fibrosis-causing deletion in populations of European descent.

DD.user_guidance: Homozygous for the deltaF508 deletion. Clinical geneticist evaluation and CFTR modulator therapy evaluation indicated.

DI.user_guidance: Heterozygous carrier. Carrier reproductive screening recommended for partner.

II.phenotype: Normal genotype: Negative for CFTR deltaF508.

caveats: Negative deltaF508 result does not rule out other CFTR mutations (residual carrier risk remains ~1 in 160).

interpretation.phenotype_summary: CYP2C19*2 creates an aberrant splice site producing a non-functional enzyme; causes clopidogrel resistance.

AA.phenotype: CYP2C19 Poor Metabolizer: Marked loss of clopidogrel bioactivation; consider alternative antiplatelet (prasugrel/ticagrelor).
AA.user_guidance: Poor metabolizer status severely reduces clopidogrel efficacy. CPIC recommends alternative antiplatelet therapy.

AG.phenotype: CYP2C19 Intermediate Metabolizer: Reduced enzymatic clearance; clopidogrel resistance risk.
AG.user_guidance: Intermediate metabolizer status: reduced bioactivation of clopidogrel.

GG.phenotype: Provisional Normal Metabolizer at rs4244285. Full phenotype requires testing *3 and *17.

caveats: Testing single SNP rs4244285 (*2) does not test *3 or *17 gain-of-function alleles.
refusal_notices: Incomplete star-allele coverage refusal: Interrogating an isolated SNP (e.g. *2) cannot rule out other active, decreased, or gain-of-function alleles (e.g. *3, *4, *17) not present on this array. A full metabolizer phenotype cannot and will not be inferred without complete haplotype sequencing.

interpretation.phenotype_summary: MTHFR C677T confers reduced enzymatic thermolability and mild homocysteine elevation without established primary disease causality.

AA.user_guidance: Practice guidelines (ACMG/ACOG) do not recommend clinical intervention or routine screening for MTHFR C677T alone.

AG.phenotype: MTHFR 677CT carrier: Modest enzyme thermolability (~65% residual activity); clinically unremarkable.
AG.user_guidance: Heterozygous carrier; benign population variant with no established standalone pathology.

caveats: Evidence Tier C: ACMG and ACOG practice guidelines advise AGAINST routine testing for MTHFR polymorphisms due to lack of clinical utility.

interpretation.phenotype_summary: ALDH2*2 Glu504Lys acts as a dominant-negative mutant, severely inactivating mitochondrial acetaldehyde dehydrogenase.

AA.phenotype: ALDH2*2 homozygote: Near-complete loss of acetaldehyde dehydrogenase activity; severe flushing and toxicity.
AA.user_guidance: Marked acetaldehyde toxicity upon alcohol ingestion. Strict avoidance of alcohol recommended to minimize esophageal cancer risk.

AG.phenotype: ALDH2*2 heterozygote: Facial flushing, nausea, and tachycardia with alcohol; elevated esophageal cancer risk if consuming alcohol.
AG.user_guidance: Substantial facial flushing and tachycardia on alcohol ingestion. Moderate-to-high esophageal cancer risk multiplier.

caveats: ALDH2*2 interacts strongly with alcohol intake: cancer risk elevation is only manifested upon sustained alcohol exposure.
